messages.footer: Guild history · local data · UTC dates
messages.historyIntro: Browse guild transactions from preserved data.
messages.noLeagues: No leagues in the database. Import history to display data here.
messages.unknownLeague: The league in this URL is unavailable.
messages.noReports: No saved HTML report for this league.
messages.reportsNote: Reports open in a separate tab and preserve historical valuations. They do not fetch new data.
messages.archivedTitle: Local archive; in-game status may be unknown
messages.diagIntro: Both leagues are stored in a separate SQLite database. Review the import results and comparison with preserved archives below.
messages.retry: Check your connection and try again.
messages.databaseRefreshFailed: Unable to refresh database status. Showing the last loaded result.
messages.databaseUnavailable: The database is unavailable or needs initialization. Archive previews remain independent.
messages.importNote: The import preserves raw records and separates leagues and sources. Matching checks record counts, date ranges and source CSV SHA-256. It does not confirm complete league history.
messages.noIssues: No errors detected in the history audit
messages.archiveNote: Matching means the copy and legacy project had identical files at audit time. It does not confirm complete league history or valuation accuracy.
messages.revision_changed: League data has changed. Refresh the view to load its current revision.
messages.invalid_date: Check the date filters. Use a valid calendar date.
messages.invalid_date_range: The start date cannot be later than the end date.
messages.transactions_failed: Unable to load transactions. Try again.
messages.incompatible_revision: Received an incompatible data revision. Refresh the view.
messages.transactions_timeout: Loading took too long. Try again.
messages.leagues_failed: Unable to load leagues. Try again.
messages.leagues_timeout: Loading leagues took too long. Try again.
messages.historyCompleteness: History completeness: {status}. This view uses the local database.
messages.provider.ggg-history.name: PoE2 guild stash history
messages.provider.ggg-history.detail: The public reference does not describe this resource; Guild Stashes covers PoE1. Access must be confirmed before implementing the fetcher.
messages.provider.ggg-oauth.name: GGG authorization
messages.provider.ggg-oauth.detail: OAuth is documented. New application registration is currently paused; a client with access to the required resource is needed.
messages.provider.ggg-leagues.name: GGG league catalog
messages.provider.ggg-leagues.detail: The league list supports realm=poe2 and requires service:leagues. Documentation was verified, not access for this deployment.
messages.provider.ninja-prices.name: poe.ninja economy leagues and prices
messages.provider.ninja-prices.detail: Public economy endpoints are documented. The adapter will respect caching and distinguish exchange and stash item formats.
messages.provider.ninja-categories.name: Discovering valuation categories
messages.provider.ninja-categories.detail: Documentation lists category names but does not describe a catalog endpoint. Planned: isolated reading of the published list, validation and a last known good copy.
messages.refresh.title: Data refresh
messages.refresh.statusError: Unable to read refresh status. Checking again shortly.
messages.refresh.archiveNote: Archived league: history fetching is disabled. Local data remains available.
messages.refresh.unavailableNote: The GGG history source is not yet available in this deployment.
messages.refresh.autoNote: Opening the page checks freshness in the background. Shared automatic limit: 2 attempts per hour per source.
messages.refresh.failed: Job failed. Last good data has been retained.
messages.refresh.coalesced: Using the job that is already scheduled.
messages.refresh.cooldown: The job is waiting for the source cooldown to end.
messages.refresh.automatic_limit: The automatic attempt limit has been reached.
messages.refresh.localNote: Verification checks local records against their raw data. It does not fetch history, confirm its completeness or generate a new report.
messages.refresh.error.adapter_error: Temporary adapter failure. The queue retries with backoff while attempts remain.
messages.refresh.error.source_unavailable: The source is unavailable; data has not changed.
messages.refresh.error.local_data_invalid: Inconsistent local data detected. The previous result was retained.
messages.refresh.error.interrupted: Work was interrupted during worker shutdown; the job remains queued.
messages.refresh.error.provider_limited: The provider is limiting requests. Manual fetch also respects this waiting period.
messages.refresh.error.data_changed: Data changed during verification. The result will be checked again.
messages.refresh.error.lease_expired: The previous worker lost its lease. The job will retry while attempts remain.
messages.refresh.error.automatic_limit: The retry is waiting for the shared automatic limit.
messages.refresh.error.archived: The league was archived; synchronization was stopped.
messages.refresh.error.legacy_job: A legacy job from before the worker existed cannot be executed.
messages.refresh.requestError: Unable to submit the job. Data remains available; try again.
messages.quantity.title: Quantity analysis
messages.quantity.observedOnly: This reconstructs recorded history, not the full guild inventory. Unknown movements are excluded from totals; inferred movements are marked separately.
messages.quantity.settingsNote: Stash selection and aliases can be shared as guild defaults inherited by leagues. Names absent from an older league are allowed. Saving rebuilds history in the background.
messages.quantity.aliasNote: An alias changes the stash name in analysis. Stashes sharing an alias share reconstructed coordinates within a source. Raw names remain preserved.
messages.quantity.pending: Analysis is queued or running. Source data remains available.
messages.quantity.failed: Analysis failed. The previous projection was retained. You can retry the rebuild.
messages.quantity.stats: Events: {events} · unknown: {unknown} · inferred: {inferred} · excluded stashes: {excluded} · warnings: {warnings}
messages.quantity.stateNote: State after the entire recorded history. Player and date filters do not restrict this view; stash and item filters apply. An unknown quantity means unknown state, not zero.
messages.quantity.filtersNote: Totals follow the applied history filters. Movement calculations use the full preceding history. Date filters remain in UTC.
messages.quantity.confidence.source: Direction and quantity come from the source action.
messages.quantity.confidence.derived: Difference between known states of the same item.
messages.quantity.confidence.inferred: Inferred movements; history may have omitted an operation.
messages.quantity.confidence.unknown: Insufficient evidence to determine direction and quantity.
messages.quantity.confidence.excluded: This stash is excluded by this league’s settings.
messages.quantity.reason.unknown_before: The preceding state is unknown. Modified establishes a new state but cannot resolve the first change.
messages.quantity.reason.stack_difference: Quantity change calculated from the previous known state.
messages.quantity.reason.replacement: A different item appeared at these coordinates. Removal of the old item and addition of the new item are inferred; different items are not combined into one delta.
messages.quantity.reason.explicit_added: The source Added entry describes an added quantity. Without a baseline, the total stack quantity may remain unknown.
messages.quantity.reason.explicit_removed: The source Removed entry describes a removed quantity.
messages.quantity.reason.explicit_zero: The entry has quantity zero; it creates no movement.
messages.quantity.reason.state_conflict: Quantity or item conflicts with the reconstructed state. The resulting state remains unknown.
messages.quantity.reason.ambiguous_order: Multiple entries share a timestamp and coordinates without unambiguous ID ordering. Their order is not guessed.
messages.quantity.reason.stash_excluded: This stash is not selected for analysis.
messages.quantity.error.report_unavailable: Unable to load analysis. Try again.
messages.quantity.error.revision_changed: Data changed. Refresh the history view.
messages.quantity.error.projection_changed: The projection changed. Refresh the analysis.
messages.quantity.error.settings_changed: Settings changed in another tab. Reload before saving again.
messages.quantity.error.invalid_timezone: Invalid timezone. Use an IANA name, such as Europe/Warsaw.
messages.quantity.error.alias_chain: Aliases cannot form chains or cycles. Specify the destination name directly.
messages.quantity.error.invalid_date_range: The start date cannot be later than the end.
messages.quantity.inheriting: Inheriting guild settings. Item states are reconstructed separately from the start of each league.
messages.quantity.overridden: This league overrides the guild defaults.
messages.quantity.error.ambiguous_guild: This league cannot be associated with a single guild source. Save league settings instead.
